note: Made-up company announcements: sample data for the roadmap notebooks. Brightleaf is a made-up company; every name, date, and rule here is invented.

announcements.title: Two-factor authentication for all accounts
announcements.text: From today, two-factor authentication is required for every work account. Set it up in the password manager. The help desk can help on extension 4400.

announcements.title: New coffee machine
announcements.text: The kitchen on the second floor has a new coffee machine. It also makes tea and hot chocolate.

announcements.title: Speak-up form is open
announcements.text: The anonymous speak-up form is now open. You can find it in the HR portal under 'Report a problem'.

announcements.title: Longer passwords
announcements.text: Passwords for work accounts must now have at least 14 characters instead of 12. You will be asked to change your password at your next login.

announcements.title: Two more company cars
announcements.text: Two more electric cars have joined the car-sharing pool, so Brightleaf now has four. Book them in the car-sharing app.

announcements.title: Longer parental leave
announcements.text: Paid parental leave grows from 12 to 16 weeks for every child born or adopted from 1 September 2025.

announcements.title: Office closed over the holidays
announcements.text: The office is closed from 24 December to 1 January. You can still work from home on those days if you need to.

announcements.title: New handbook version
announcements.text: Version 3.2 of the employee handbook is valid from January 2026. The biggest change is the rule for working from another country.

announcements.title: New VPN app
announcements.text: A new VPN app replaces the old one. Install it from the software center before 31 March 2026; after that date, the old app stops working.

announcements.title: Bike parking in the basement
announcements.text: The basement now has 40 bike parking spaces and two charging points for e-bikes. Use your badge to open the gate.

announcements.title: Phishing training
announcements.text: Every employee completes a 20-minute phishing training in the learning portal by 31 July 2026.

announcements.title: Book your learning days
announcements.text: Remember to book your five paid learning days for this year in the HR portal before 30 November 2026.
